STEP 1 - Scene: An airline-style tray meal with several compartments: lasagne, mixed vegetables, roasted potatoes with chicken, noodles, and a fruit cup, plus a drink and a bottle. The main plate is the centre of the meal; the lasagne plate and noodle dish sit at the edges of the tray and are treated as part of this meal since they are on the same tray.

STEP 2 - Vessel: Main plate is a white paper dinner plate, about 22 cm diameter. Area = 3.14 x 11^2 = 380 cm^2.

STEP 3 - Items on main plate: roasted potatoes (3-4 small), sliced chicken breast and a chicken drumstick, with mixed vegetables in a separate bowl (~17 cm, treated separately) and fruit cup (small dish). Lasagne (side plate ~20 cm) and noodles (small dish ~15 cm) are on their own dishes.

STEP 4 - Area (percent of main plate, 380 cm^2):
- Roasted potatoes: 12% = 46 cm^2 x 2.5 cm = 114 ml x 0.9 = 103 g x 110 kcal/100g = 113 kcal
- Chicken (breast slices plus drumstick): 22% = 84 cm^2 x 2 cm = 168 ml x 0.95 = 160 g x 190 kcal/100g = 304 kcal

Covered share is about 34%; the rest of the plate is empty.

Other dishes (treated as separate vessels on the tray):
- Lasagne: side plate 20 cm, 314 cm^2, about 60% covered = 188 cm^2 x 2.5 cm = 470 ml x 0.9 = 423 g x 135 kcal/100g = 571 kcal
- Mixed vegetables bowl: about 60% of a 17 cm bowl (227 cm^2) = 136 cm^2 x 3 cm = 408 ml x 0.55 = 224 g x 40 kcal/100g = 90 kcal
- Noodles (small dish ~15 cm, 177 cm^2, about 70% covered = 124 cm^2 x 2 cm = 248 ml x 0.8 = 198 g x 150 kcal/100g = 297 kcal
- Fruit cup (small bowl ~10 cm, 79 cm^2, about 70% covered = 55 cm^2 x 2 cm = 110 ml x 0.6 = 66 g x 50 kcal/100g = 33 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The main plate alone is about 260 g, and the full tray holds roughly 1,100 g of food. Energy totals about 1,100 kcal, which fits a full airline meal with lasagne, chicken, noodles, and vegetables.
